At BulkSocksWholesale.com we offer a unique opportunity for consumers to purchase small lots of
wholesale socks as well as a range of other wearable categories at below retail prices. Whether you
are stocking up on wholesale socks and underwear for yourself, buying for your entire family, or
outfitting a sports team, savings are big, either by the dozen or the hundreds. Neither men or women
can have too many pairs of socks. Especially when they can shop for them in bulk. Here's a chance to
fill your dresser drawer from our menu of wholesale socks— dress, crew, ankle, and even diabetic—
for super savings. Check the site often for new arrivals

## Top Quality Bottom Price

Forget about the retail stores, and their so-called discount deals. When a customer opens an account
with us they know every item they add to their shopping cart , no matter the quantities, is below
the big box store discount prices. We buy our products in bulk, and pass the savings on to you.

## Wide Selection Of Styles

Available in both cotton and polyester, our socks cradle the foot from toe to heel, and circle the
ankle with just the right amount of stretch to keep them from slipping down. No loafers here, even
when snuggled inside a pair! Speaking of pairs, order a dozen crew socks to be sure a clean, dry
supply is on hand for the big game. Either on the field wearing cleats, or on the sideline in street
shoes, your feet will thank you for wearing our high performance socks.

## Socks for Work, Socks For Play

After a session in the gym, head back to work—or out on the town!— in our dress socks. These
lightweight, above-the-calf socks support your feet and legs from dawn to dusk, while being the
height of fashion. And don't forget our wholesale socks for diabetics. Not just for diabetes any
more. Smart sock wearers have discovered these thick and comfortable socks are great for everyday
use by everyone with tender feet, poor circulation, and heavy calves. Perfect for cold nights
beneath the blankets in these non-constricting foot warmers.

## High Fashion At A Low Price

Your savings from buying wholesale socks over retail will be enough to extend the shopping trip to
our clothing and accessories options. Every page has a style and design for men, women, and kids.
Cotton bandanas in every color of the rainbow. Polyester beanies are item matches in the same color.
From hoodies and jackets, ankle socks to bras and briefs, and panties and pullovers, customers can

We pride ourselves in providing high-quality socks for various needs, from everyday wear to diabetic
socks. We are a unique sock manufacturer committed to making a difference in the world. Many of our
socks are made of renewable, recycled, and plant-based [materials][123] as we strive to positively
impact the environment and hold ourselves accountable for our role as a manufacturing corporation. 

## Eco-Friendly Innovations

Our roots can be traced back to 1988, when EcoSox was BBS Hosiery, specializing in manufacturing and
distributing products to various retailers. By 2008, the goals of manufacturing shifted to higher
standards of quality and performance that consumers valued. EcoSox was born from this shift, and we
began manufacturing with viscose derived from bamboo, an incredibly sustainable resource that made
our socks even better. 

EcoSox became our brand in 2008, and since then, we have dedicated ourselves to eco-friendly
innovations in making our socks that are:
* Soft and Comfortable
* Absorb 60% More Moisture Than Cotton
* Breathable for Moisture Evaporation 
* Biodegradable and Sustainable

impact the environment and hold ourselves accountable for our role as a manufacturing corporation. 

## Eco-Friendly Innovations

Our roots can be traced back to 1988, when EcoSox was BBS Hosiery, specializing in manufacturing and
distributing products to various retailers. By 2008, the goals of manufacturing shifted to higher
standards of quality and performance that consumers valued. EcoSox was born from this shift, and we
began manufacturing with viscose derived from bamboo, an incredibly sustainable resource that made
our socks even better. 

EcoSox became our brand in 2008, and since then, we have dedicated ourselves to eco-friendly
innovations in making our socks that are:
* Soft and Comfortable
* Absorb 60% More Moisture Than Cotton
* Breathable for Moisture Evaporation 
* Biodegradable and Sustainable

## What Safety Means To Us At Indiahikes

And how that translates to your trek

play video
[imgs]

Our vision is very clear to me. Everyone must trek, because I have seen how trekking can transform
lives.

But everyone must trek keeping safety in mind. Whether they trek with us or by themselves, they must
trek safely. There are no two ways about it. To do that, the safety systems of an organisation need
to be in place.

I know that Indiahikes is regarded across the country as India's safest trekking organisation. But
we are not sitting on it. Our entire team is working to see what the future of safety can be. And
this is an endless journey. Five years from now, you will hear me saying the same thing.

And that's how it must be. Safety cannot have a full stop. But what it can have is the quest to make
treks safer and safer. And that's how I see it.

**Arjun Majumdar**

**Founder, CEO, Indiahikes**

play video

Our vision is very clear to me. Everyone must trek, because I have seen how trekking can transform
lives.

But everyone must trek keeping safety in mind. Whether they trek with us or by themselves, they must
trek safely. There are no two ways about it. To do that, the safety systems of an organisation need
to be in place.

I know that Indiahikes is regarded across the country as India's safest trekking organisation. But
we are not sitting on it. Our entire team is working to see what the future of safety can be. And
this is an endless journey. Five years from now, you will hear me saying the same thing.

And that's how it must be. Safety cannot have a full stop. But what it can have is the quest to make
treks safer and safer. And that's how I see it.

**Arjun Majumdar**

**Independent media and independent brands have a lot in common.**

Showers Pass isn't backed by a conglomerate or VC dollars. We're a small Portland-based team that
believes weather shouldn't keep people from riding, and we build gear to prove it. The outlets we're
partnering with aren't backed by big money either. They're run by people who care deeply about
cycling and made a bet that readers would too. In these times of increasing consolidation, we think
it’s important to call out the value of your support for independent brands and media.

## ABOUT JSSOX

About Us

### **ZHUJI JIESI KNITTING CO.,LTD**

Located in Datang, international highly-productive home to socks in China, Zhuji Jssox factory has
the priority of mature hosiery manufacturing and exports around the world for decades.With
craftsmanship passed down through generations, we are proud to inherit the strong expertise and
possess sound streamline managements--Our factory covers 6000 square meters with vertical
integration from material processing, manufacturing, packing and delivering. We have introduced
advanced computer knitting machines, There are 120 sets of hosiery knitters, including single and
double cylinders with 72 needles, 84 needles, 96 needles, 108 needles, 120 needles, 144 needles, 168
needles, 200 needles.

## Sock Styles We Offer

A variety of premium sock styles to choose from to best suit your needs; with styles for on- and off
the field.

#### Premium Crew Socks

A favourite for a reason. Engineered for versatility and comfort. The perfect all-rounder for daily
wear, corporate branding, and any activity you can think of.

#### Ribbed Crew Socks

A stylish take on a classic. This sock features a distinctive texture and a relaxed fit, combining a
casual look with enhanced breathability for everyday comfort.

#### Casual Crew Socks

The ideal choice for high-quantity promotional gifting. Featuring a one-size-fits-most design and a
low-profile seamed toe for accessible comfort.

#### Anklet Socks

Sitting just above the ankle, this style is a firm favourite for running clubs, schools, and
athletic teams, offering a balance of coverage and freedom.

#### No-Show Tab Socks

A low-profile sock with a protective anti-slide tab at the heel to prevent blisters and slippage.
Provides discreet, all-day comfort.

#### Performance Knee-Highs

Premium Compression socks. Preferred  by runners, equestrian teams and field sport athletes. Now
with a certified Category D Compression rating.

#### Merino Wool Socks

Experience the natural performance of Merino wool. These socks provide superior temperature
regulation and moisture-wicking comfort, available in versatile crew or specialized ski designs.

#### Protective Arm Sleeves

Seamless, comfortable, and protective. Our arm sleeves offer CANSA-certified SPF 50+ UV resistance,
making them perfect for outdoor sports and activities.

#### Branded Sweatbands

A classic accessory for tennis, gym sessions, and events. Highly absorbent and features a prominent
branding area to showcase your logo.

## Sock Styles We Offer

A variety of premium sock styles to choose from to best suit your needs; with styles for on- and off
the field.

#### Premium Crew Socks

A favourite for a reason. Engineered for versatility and comfort. The perfect all-rounder for daily
wear, corporate branding, and any activity you can think of.

#### Ribbed Crew Socks

A stylish take on a classic. This sock features a distinctive texture and a relaxed fit, combining a
casual look with enhanced breathability for everyday comfort.

#### Casual Crew Socks

The ideal choice for high-quantity promotional gifting. Featuring a one-size-fits-most design and a
low-profile seamed toe for accessible comfort.

#### Anklet Socks

Sitting just above the ankle, this style is a firm favourite for running clubs, schools, and
athletic teams, offering a balance of coverage and freedom.

#### No-Show Tab Socks

A low-profile sock with a protective anti-slide tab at the heel to prevent blisters and slippage.
Provides discreet, all-day comfort.

#### Performance Knee-Highs

Premium Compression socks. Preferred  by runners, equestrian teams and field sport athletes. Now
with a certified Category D Compression rating.

#### Merino Wool Socks

Experience the natural performance of Merino wool. These socks provide superior temperature
regulation and moisture-wicking comfort, available in versatile crew or specialized ski designs.

#### Protective Arm Sleeves

Seamless, comfortable, and protective. Our arm sleeves offer CANSA-certified SPF 50+ UV resistance,
making them perfect for outdoor sports and activities.

#### Branded Sweatbands

A classic accessory for tennis, gym sessions, and events. Highly absorbent and features a prominent
branding area to showcase your logo.
